emails.subject: Notice of Routine Quality Audit - Protocol SP-101, Site 105 (Maple Creek Clinical Research)
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

This email is to formally notify you that Site 105, Maple Creek Clinical Research (PI: Dr. Alan Grant), has been selected for a routine quality assurance audit for study SP-101.

We are proposing the audit take place over two days during the week of November 13th or November 20th, 2023. 

Please liaise with the site to determine their availability during these weeks. Once we have a potential date, I will send a formal agenda and confirmation.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,

David Chen
Senior QA Auditor
Stellaris Pharma

description: An email from the sponsor's Quality Assurance (QA) department notifying the CRA that one of their assigned sites has been selected for a routine quality audit. The thread involves the CRA coordinating with the QA auditor and the site PI to schedule the audit and providing the site with a list of documents to prepare for the inspection.
